card.name: Snatch Steal
card.officialText: Equip only to an opponent's monster. Take control of the equipped monster. Once per turn, during your opponent's Standby Phase: They gain 1000 LP.

behavior: Equip Spell from active physical representative hand in open Main Phase; face-up opponent monster target
no LP cost at activation; control transfer occurs only on resolution
preserve physical UID, owner, position and face-up state; no summon flag is added
when Equip leaves field, return monster to the controller it had immediately before the steal, or to the latest still-active Snatch Steal controller
if destination team has no Monster Zone when control returns, destroy monster to physical owner's GY and clear all attached Snatch Steals
if equipped monster leaves field, send every linked Snatch Steal to its physical owner's GY
classic 2004 face-down handling: send attached Equip Spells to GY while leaving monster under current controller
each active copy grants 1000 LP to opponent team during that team's Standby Phase once per turn, even if another effect has returned control
replay protection, sequence ordering for multiple Snatch Steals, inventory conservation and immutable input

limitations: Adapter ainda não está registrado no resolver v9/catálogo; não certifica nem torna Snatch Steal jogável em produção.
Standby Phase e retorno de controle foram exercitados em TagDuel temporário; integração com scheduler/handler real ainda depende do resolver.
Regra de face-down segue ruling TCG clássico de 2004; deve ser confirmada contra a política histórica final do projeto antes de certificação.
